summary: No local mirror: drop the source-command write-through into SQLite, remove the MCP sql tool, hide workflow status from MCP, rewrite the MCP context text, and sandbox the client tests.
reason: coinlocker-navi.com's terms forbid copying beyond private use, so the CLI must stay on-demand. The generated resolveRead auto/live path called writeThroughCache, which upserted every live source search/locker/ekicube result into ~/.local/share/coinlocker-navi-pp-cli/data.db, and the MCP sql tool ('Requires sync first') and workflow_status ('Add a site-specific sync command') pointed agents at that store. writeThroughCache, its envelope helpers and the unused writeMutationResponseToStore family are removed; sql is no longer registered (handleSQL and its tests stay as generated library code); workflow status carries mcp:hidden; the context tool names only context, near, locker, vacancy and the raw source_* tools and states the honesty rules. internal/client had no TestMain, so client tests resolved the real cache dir and removed <cache>/http/resources; main_test.go now runs them under testenv.RunSandboxed.
call_sites: No sql tool: this CLI keeps no local store
There is no local store and no sql, search or sync tool
validated_outcome: TestSourceReadDoesNotWriteLocalStore, TestMCPRegisterToolsPreservesTypedSpecialTools and TestMCPContextNamesOnlyRealTools pass; tools/list over stdio lists context, locker, near, source_ekicube, source_locker, source_search, vacancy; a probe under ~/.cache/coinlocker-navi-pp-cli/http/resources/ survives go test -count=1 ./....
